title: Earthquakes
text:
An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground. It happens when large pieces of rock under the Earth move suddenly. Most earthquakes are small, but some can destroy buildings and roads. Scientists use special machines to measure them.

A strong earthquake hit a small town by the sea. Many houses fell down, and some roads were closed. Rescue teams came quickly to help the people. After that, the town started building stronger houses.

questions.text: What happens when large pieces of rock under the Earth move suddenly?
options: A storm starts over the sea

questions.text: What did the rescue teams do after the earthquake in the town?
options: They came quickly to help the people

questions.text: Why did the town start building stronger houses?
options: Because the earthquake made many houses fall down
Because the town wanted a new river
Because the houses were too small for families
Because the sea was getting closer

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about earthquakes?
options: They can be dangerous even though many are small
They only happen near the sea

vocabulary.definition: a sudden, strong movement of the ground
moving quickly from side to side or up and down
the act of saving people from danger
more able to resist damage or pressure

paragraph_translations: Um terremoto é um tremor repentino do chão. Ele acontece quando grandes pedaços de rocha debaixo da Terra se movem de repente. A maioria dos terremotos é pequena, mas alguns podem destruir prédios e estradas. Os cientistas usam máquinas especiais para medi-los.

Um forte terremoto atingiu uma pequena cidade à beira-mar. Muitas casas caíram e algumas estradas foram fechadas. Equipes de resgate chegaram rapidamente para ajudar as pessoas. Depois disso, a cidade começou a construir casas mais resistentes.
